olivia-customer: Hi — signed up a few minutes ago via GitHub and added a payment method (Klarna, EU). Completed the 3DS redirect but I don't see the free trial credits in the dashboard. Email olivia@example.com. Can someone check?

matt-support: Sorry about that — can you paste the customer id from your account (or DM it)? Also which country did you set during signup?

olivia-customer: Sure, account id is cus_01G7YZ9ABCD. I was in Germany (DE). Browser showed 3DS success and bank page returned OK. Card masked ends with 4242, BIN looks EU.

matt-support: thanks. @kevin-payments can you look for any onboarding gating logs for cus_01G7YZ9ABCD?

kevin-payments: pulling logs now. I see a payment_intent.succeeded webhook at 1953999999, and our trial-grant worker attempted to run but failed with: 
```
ERROR grant-queue: grant_worker.handle(cus_01G7YZ9ABCD) -> region_mismatch: signup_country=DE ip_country=IE
stack: grant/worker.go:142
```

kevin-payments: looks like the signup IP geolocated to Ireland (IE) while the billing address/payment method is DE. We have a gate that delays auto-grant for EU signups when bin_country != ip_country to reduce chargeback abuse.

matt-support: olivia, any chance you were on a VPN or corporate proxy during signup?

olivia-customer: Ah — yes, I was on my work VPN which exits in Dublin. Forgot to turn it off. Would that block the trial?

kevin-payments: yep, that'll trigger the gate. We can manually apply the trial if account is legit. @billing-bot can you enqueue a manual_grant for cus_01G7YZ9ABCD (reason: ip-vpn mismatch, verified by customer)?

billing-bot: manual_grant request received from @kevin-payments for cus_01G7YZ9ABCD — queued. ETA ~10m. :white_check_mark:

matt-support: I'll monitor and confirm once the grant completes. Sorry for the friction, we'll add clearer messaging in the signup flow. :pray:

olivia-customer: Thanks — appreciate the help!

kevin-payments: manual_grant executed at 1954000105. Backend log: `credits.add(cus_01G7YZ9ABCD, amount=50, source=manual_grant, admin=kevin-payments)` — balance updated.

olivia-customer: Verified! I see the $50 trial credit now. :tada:

matt-support: Note added to account: `{cause: ip-vpn, action: manual_grant, performed_by: kevin-payments, ticket: RW-3175}`. Closing loop with product for UX clarity.

sara-sre: Filed RW-3175 with product-ux (repro steps, logs attached). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RW-3175

matt-support: closing thread — feel free to reopen if anything else comes up. Thanks everyone. :wave:
